title: Eye exam for premature babies (retinopathy)
what: An eye doctor checks the retina of a baby who was born early. This finds changes in time, while they can be treated.
why: For babies born early or with a low birth weight. The doctor sets the timing and how often exams are done.
duration: the exam usually takes 10 to 15 minutes; before it, there are drops and about an hour of waiting
tell_doctor: How early your baby was born and the birth weight
If your baby was on oxygen
Dates and results of past exams

prepare.title: Feeding
prepare.text: It is usually best to feed your baby about 1 hour before the exam. Ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Drops
prepare.text: Before the exam, drops are put in to widen the pupils. You will need to wait.

prepare.title: Dates
prepare.text: Do not miss the scheduled dates. This is important.

bring: Discharge notes from the maternity or neonatal unit
A diaper, a blanket, and a bottle
steps: A nurse puts in drops several times
You wait for the pupils to widen
Your baby is swaddled and held gently
The doctor puts in numbing drops
A small device gently holds the eyelids open
The doctor looks at the back of the eye through a lens
feel: It is unpleasant for your baby, and they usually cry
This passes quickly after the exam
The exam itself does not harm the eye
after: The eyelids may be a little red for a few hours
The doctor will tell you the result and the date of the next exam
If treatment is needed, it will be discussed right away
red_flags: Severe eyelid swelling or pus from the eye
Your baby is limp, feeds poorly, or spits up more than usual
Your baby stops breathing or turns blue: call emergency services

faq.q: Why check if the eyes look normal?
faq.a: Changes in the retina cannot be seen from outside. They are found only during the exam.

faq.q: Is the exam dangerous for my baby?
faq.a: It is a routine check for premature babies. It is unpleasant for the baby, but harm is very rare.

reminders.text: Baby's eye exam tomorrow. Feed your baby beforehand and bring the discharge notes.
